Card Q&A.a: After checking the card, place it back on top of your deck face down.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card's [On Play] effect to check the top card of my deck. What happens to that card?

Effect: [On Play] Look at the top card of your deck.
[On Deletion] Reveal 3 cards from the top of your deck. You may play 1 [Monitamon] among them without paying its memory cost. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
